description: A function passed to a camelCase prop like `onClick`. Pass the function, do not call it.
React's cross-browser event wrapper with `target`, `currentTarget`, `preventDefault()` and `stopPropagation()`.
Cancels the browser default, such as a page reload on form submit.
Stops an event from bubbling to ancestor handlers.
`new FormData(form)` reads every named field of a form; `data.get('query')` returns one value.
